
### Manchester encoding 

![](/physical/texfig/signal-sync-manchester-encoding.figure.svg)
 Figure 25 from Section 2.2 of Computer Networks: A Systems Approach (6th ed) (Peterson and Davie)

### problem with Manchester  {.smaller}


* fixed the problem of too few transitions
* but now most transitions don't send information
* means we aren't making good use of wire/etc. capacity
* there are more clever compromises 

   * (example: 4B5B encoding)
